text:
A. Create an order and follow its eligible stages
Given the Owner is signed in and a customer profile exists
When the Owner opens Create Order or New order and selects the customer
Then the system shall display the customer type, delivery address and previous order quantity
When a positive whole-number gallon quantity is entered
Then the system shall apply the customer-type unit price and calculate the order total
When Save Order is selected
Then the system shall assign a unique Order ID, save the date/time and recording account, set Ordered and display "Order saved"
When the saved order is opened
Then the system shall display its customer details, gallon tracking, operational status and separate payment information
When the eligible next stage For Pickup is selected
Then the system shall update the order to For Pickup
When a valid pickup is recorded and refilling begins
Then the system shall allow Picked Up followed by Refilling
When Ready for Delivery is saved with sufficient empty stock
Then the system shall convert the required empty gallons into filled gallons once
When a delivery leaves a remainder
Then the order shall be Undelivered with pending gallons
When all remaining gallons are delivered
Then the order shall become Delivered without changing its original monetary total.

Sample Data:
